zinou.title: From ZINOU butcher to your plate
zinou.badge: 100% of our meat comes from ZINOU butcher
zinou.text: At Sushi Smile, our meat never comes from industrial suppliers. We source it directly from ZINOU, our trusted local butcher. The result: fresh, fully traceable meat prepared on site — for dishes you can enjoy with complete peace of mind.
zinou.feat1Text: Picked from the butcher every day, never prepared in advance.
zinou.feat2Text: From the butcher straight to your plate, no industrial middleman.
zinou.feat3Text: The same high standard with every order, in every season.
zinou.feat4Text: Rigorously selected products, cooked in our own kitchen.
zinou.products: saté chicken, the chicken in our bowls, beef & cheese skewers and every meat-based dish we make.
zinou.imageAlt: Grilled glazed meat skewers prepared at Sushi Smile
